text:
jordan: Heads-up: seeing repeated latency spikes in eu-west dedicated pool A over last 6 hours. Pattern looks like 10-20% tail on small token gen. Could be noisy neighbor or egress microbursts. Samples attached.
preeti: Do we have tenant ids for the affected allocations? Any repeated slices?
jordan: Alloc IDs: alloc-72c3 / alloc-72f9 / alloc-fingerprint shows bursty egress from one tenant. Not CPU/GPU thermal. Telemetry shows high NIC rx drops.
liam: Thinking of running a 'noise fingerprint' sweep: use eBPF to sample skb queues + per-process perf counters, combine with kvcache miss traces. Low overhead. I can push a probe to canary rack.
anya: Love it. Can we also check vGPU isolate flags? Some vgpu drivers misreport queue depth -> we misroute.
jordan: Propose flow: 1) deploy eBPF probe via rollout 2) correlate with allocator logs 3) label tenant as 'fingerprint:egress-spike' 4) route to soft-quarantine (dedicated slice) for 1h and observe. @sam you cool with automated label and routing?
sam: Yep. Add metric -> noise.score and a 90th lat delta. If > 0.3 for > 5m then tag. Ops-bot, create incident stub.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-047 - NoiseFingerprintSweep - channel #eng-infra for updates
preeti: Quick probe snippet I'm about to push: ```bpftrace -e 'kprobe:netif_receive_skb { @drops[comm] = count(); }'``` will sample rx path. Also `perf stat -e cache-misses -p <pid>` for process pids.
liam: I'll combine results with kvcache logs. Two caveats: 1) eBPF on older kernels must be verified, 2) avoid sampling on high-traffic racks.
jordan: Can we limit to eu-west-b pool only for first sweep? Want to avoid cross-region churn.
anya: Agreed. Also let's not auto-evict until ops confirm. Soft-quarantine should just route new allocs to dedicated small slice and cap egress to 200Mbps.
sam: I'll make the automation PR: will add a safelist override per tenant; will run canary for 30min then auto-tag. PR link: http://go/pr/infra/noise-sweep
preeti: :thumbsup: after sweep we should run cost estimate. Dedicated slices cost ~1.2x; labeling frequently could ramp cost.
jordan: Plan: start sweep 3pm UTC. Ops oncall: @anya @liam. If noise.score persists > 20m escalate.
anya: Oncall ack. Will monitor dashboards and manually approve any hard-evicts.
sam: Putting a small alert: 'noise.fingerprint >0.3 for 10m' -> slack to #eng-infra and webhook to ticketing.
jordan: Thanks everyone. Will post preliminary results in ~2h.
